;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian civil war]], [[Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020)]], [[Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War]]
**[[President of Turkey|Turkish President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] says Turkey will not allow [[Syria]]'s military to gain more ground in the rebel-held [[Idlib Governorate]], as the [[Syrian Army]] captures several more villages near the city of [[Saraqib]]. Turkish officials say intermittent clashes between Turkish and Syrian troops have continued since Monday. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-51371462 (BBC News)]

;Disasters and accidents
* A magnitude 5.0 [[earthquake]] hits 20 kilometers south of [[Guánica, Puerto Rico]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/02/04/us/puerto-rico-earthquake/index.html (CNN)] [https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/pr2020035028/executive (National Earthquake Center)]

;Health and environment 
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in China]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
****[[Government of China|Chinese]] [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China|Foreign Ministry]] spokeswoman [[Hua Chunying]] reports the death toll has surpassed 400 with over 20,000 people infected, and requests the [[United States]] "not to overreact". [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-health-usa-aid/china-says-u-s-should-not-overreact-on-coronavirus-outbreak-idUSKBN1ZY03N (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong]]
****The second [[COVID-19|coronavirus]] death outside [[mainland China]] is reported in [[Hong Kong]]. The victim was a 34-year-old Hongkonger who had recently travelled to [[Wuhan]], the center of the pandemic. The [[Hospital Authority]] said the victim suffered from "preexisting health conditions", but did not give details. [https://www.latimes.com/world-nation/story/2020-02-04/coronavirus-first-hong-kong-death-workers-strike (''Los Angeles Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic on cruise ships]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic on Diamond Princess]]
****The ''[[Diamond Princess (ship)|Diamond Princess]]'' cruise ship is [[quarantine]]d and tested for coronavirus cases as it is docked in [[Yokohama]], Japan. Passengers and crew are now required to stay on board until at least Tuesday night. Between 3,500 and 3,700 passengers are tested. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/02/04/asia/coronavirus-japan-cruise-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]

;Law and crime
*[[Algerian President]] [[Abdelmadjid Tebboune]] pardons more than 3,000 prisoners serving sentences of less than six months imprisonment as he seeks to win support after months of political turmoil. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-algeria-pardon/algeria-pardons-thousands-of-prisoners-idUSKBN1ZY24G?il=0 (Reuters)]
* First Lady of [[Lesotho]], [[Maesiah Thabane]], is arrested and charged in connection to the 2017 murder of [[Lipolelo Thabane]], ex-wife of current [[List of prime ministers of Lesotho|Prime Minister]] [[Tom Thabane]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/feb/04/lesotho-first-lady-to-be-charged-with-murder (''The Guardian'')]
*Gunmen kill 9 people, including 3 children, in a video arcade in [[Uruapan]], [[Mexico]]. [https://6abc.com/5903440/ (''ABC News'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]], [[2020 Republican Party presidential primaries]]	
**[[Donald Trump]] receives overwhelming support in the [[2020 Iowa Republican presidential caucuses|Iowa Republican caucuses]] while the results of the [[2020 Iowa Democratic presidential caucuses|Iowa Democratic caucuses]] are delayed because of problems with the use of a [[Shadow Inc.#IowaReporterApp|mobile app]] for reporting. [https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/iowa-caucuses-live-results-coverage-2020/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2020 State of the Union Address]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] delivers [[2020 State of the Union Address|his third State of the Union Address]] to the [[116th United States Congress]] in the chamber of the [[United States House of Representatives|House of Representatives]]. It was Trump's [[2017 Donald Trump speech to a joint session of Congress|fourth and final speech]] to a [[joint session of the United States Congress]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/02/04/politics/state-of-the-union-2020-donald-trump/index.html (CNN)]
